objectClass.notes: Single-view front-right isometric photograph, 750x1020. Reference image is technically suitable (probe_image.py returned pass) and the object has rotational/bilateral symmetry sufficient to infer hidden geometry.

reasoning: Three macro assemblies (backrest, seat, frame) plus one repetition system (4 legs).
Six meso parts: backrest-top, backrest-seam-strip, seat-top-cushion, seat-front-bevel, frame-front-rail, frame-legs+glides.
Five micro features: horizontal seam, front bevel, cantilever curve, brushed metal anisotropy, glide feet, fabric weave micro-relief (counted six — the threshold is five).
Three distinct materials: navy upholstery (matte cloth), brushed steel frame, near-black plastic glides.
Single-view occlusion risk is moderate: back face of backrest, inside faces of legs, and rear-left leg are inferred but not directly visible.

specDepthDecision.rationale: moderate complexity + bilateral symmetry justifies macro+meso hierarchy, repetition system for the 4 legs, and material local overrides for brushed anisotropy and weave micro-relief. No action rigging needed (chair is a static prop).

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation.description: Back face of backrest not visible. Will be modeled as flat rear panel of same fabric (low confidence).
Inside faces of frame legs (the side facing chair center) not visible.
Rear-left leg entirely hidden behind the seat.
Leg cross-section could be round or rounded-rectangular; image suggests rounded-rectangular but not certain.

detailInventory.note: See detail-inventory.json for the full per-detail records. Seven identity-defining features enumerated, each mapping to a component.localFeatures or material.localOverrides entry.

anatomy.note: Object domain — anatomy section does not apply.

definitionOfDone: Bilateral symmetry respected; silhouette matches the chair reference within moderate tolerance.
All five identity-defining features present and visible from the reference camera angle.
Three materials wired: navy upholstery, brushed metal frame, matte black glides.
Four legs visible as a repetition system; back-of-seat face and inside-leg faces flagged low-confidence in code comments.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Aspect ratio taller-than-wide matches reference (back-height ~1.5x seat-depth).
Bilateral symmetry plane through seat centerline.
Backrest and seat combined into a single padded envelope above the sled frame.
failureModes: model reads as a generic box
backrest and seat merged into single cushion without seam hint

featureGroups.name: Primary structure and hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Three macros: backrest, seat, frame.
Frame is parent of legs+rails+glides.
Backrest-top and backrest-seam are siblings under backrest.
Seat-top-cushion and seat-front-bevel are siblings under seat.
failureModes: frame and seat merged into single mesh

featureGroups.name: Cantilever sled-base
qualityCriteria: Each leg is a single bent tube (sled), not four straight legs.
Visible front cross-rail under seat front.
Four legs total: two front, two rear, mirror-placed.
failureModes: four straight legs instead of sled-base

featureGroups.name: Backrest horizontal seam
qualityCriteria: Single horizontal seam at mid-height of backrest.
Seam strip is same navy fabric as backrest (not contrasting).
Seam visible from reference camera angle.
failureModes: seam strip missing or wrong height

featureGroups.name: Upholstery material response
qualityCriteria: Albedo deep navy (~#1c2c52), matte (roughness ~0.85), dielectric.
Subtle weave micro-relief on seat front lit edge.
No specular highlights (cloth).
failureModes: upholstery reads as flat blue plastic

featureGroups.name: Frame brushed metal
qualityCriteria: Brushed steel finish, light grey, anisotropic vertical brushing on legs.
Round-rectangular cross-section inferred (low confidence).
No painting / no contrast on the metal.
failureModes: brushing absent or in wrong direction

featureGroups.name: Foot glides
qualityCriteria: Small dark matte plastic feet at each leg end.
~5% of leg height, near-black.

visualDeltaChecks: silhouette and negative-space delta against chair.png
single horizontal seam visible at mid-back
navy upholstery albedo and matte roughness
brushed metal frame finish on legs
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if only root component is authored (must have backrest/seat/frame macros).
Do not omit any of the five identity-defining features.
Do not reuse albedo for roughness or normal channels.
Do not merge frame and seat into one mesh.
